from solution import specified_element


def test_issue_example_from_issue():
    """Extract every specified element from a given two dimensional list as in example."""
    result = specified_element([[1, 2, 3, 2], [4, 5, 6, 2], [7, 1, 9, 5]], 0)
    # hand: row0[0]=1, row1[0]=4, row2[0]=7 => [1, 4, 7]
    assert result == [1, 4, 7]


def test_issue_second_column():
    """Extract every specified element with N=1 gives second element of each row."""
    result = specified_element([[1, 2, 3, 2], [4, 5, 6, 2], [7, 1, 9, 5]], 1)
    # hand: row0[1]=2, row1[1]=5, row2[1]=1 => [2, 5, 1]
    assert result == [2, 5, 1]


def test_issue_third_column():
    """Extract every specified element with N=2 gives third element of each row."""
    result = specified_element([[1, 2, 3, 2], [4, 5, 6, 2], [7, 1, 9, 5]], 2)
    # hand: row0[2]=3, row1[2]=6, row2[2]=9 => [3, 6, 9]
    assert result == [3, 6, 9]


def test_issue_last_column_boundary():
    """Extract every specified element with last valid index N=3 gives last element."""
    result = specified_element([[1, 2, 3, 2], [4, 5, 6, 2], [7, 1, 9, 5]], 3)
    # hand: row0[3]=2, row1[3]=2, row2[3]=5 => [2, 2, 5]
    assert result == [2, 2, 5]


def test_issue_single_row():
    """Extract every specified element from a single-row two dimensional list."""
    result = specified_element([[10, 20, 30]], 1)
    # hand: row0[1]=20 with 1 row => [20]
    assert result == [20]


def test_issue_single_column():
    """Extract every specified element with N=0 from single-column rows."""
    result = specified_element([[1], [2], [3]], 0)
    # hand: row0[0]=1, row1[0]=2, row2[0]=3 => [1, 2, 3]
    assert result == [1, 2, 3]


def test_issue_single_element_matrix():
    """Extract every specified element from a 1x1 two dimensional list."""
    result = specified_element([[42]], 0)
    # hand: row0[0]=42 with 1 row => [42]
    assert result == [42]


def test_issue_empty_outer_list():
    """Extract every specified element from empty two dimensional list gives empty list."""
    result = specified_element([], 0)
    # hand: 0 rows => 0 elements => []
    assert result == []


def test_issue_negatives_zeros_duplicates():
    """Extract every specified element preserves negatives, zeros and duplicates."""
    result = specified_element([[0, -1, 0], [-1, 0, -1]], 1)
    # hand: row0[1]=-1, row1[1]=0 => [-1, 0]
    assert result == [-1, 0]


def test_contract_output_length_matches_rows():
    """Result list length equals number of rows in the two dimensional list."""
    result = specified_element([[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]], 0)
    # hand: 3 rows => 1+1+1=3 elements
    assert len(result) == 3


def test_contract_input_not_mutated():
    """Calling with a two dimensional list must not mutate the input list."""
    data = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
    specified_element(data, 1)
    # hand: input [[1, 2], [3, 4]] unchanged => [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
    assert data == [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
